fusions.name: Battering Sigil
fusions.desc: Butts the target with a sigil of force that deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Bolt
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt of arcana up to 8 tiles that deals 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times at full range, and ignores armour. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Cliffside Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your arcane resistance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Refuse to Fall
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a ward of arcana absorbs damage equal to 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
